# Fixture provenance

- `gtfs-kingston-stops.sample.txt`: first five `stops.txt` rows from Kingston Transit, retrieved 2026-11-15. Attribution: Data: Kingston Transit. Licence: Open Data Licence – City of Kingston 1.0; https://opendatakingston.cityofkingston.ca/.
- `gtfs-sudbury-stops.sample.txt`: first five `stops.txt` rows from GOVA Transit (Greater Sudbury), retrieved 2026-11-15. Attribution: Data: GOVA Transit. Licence: Open Data Licence – City of Greater Sudbury; https://www.greatersudbury.ca/.
- `demo-stops-hierarchy.txt`: wholly fictional demonstration rows, not real stop data. Names beginning with Demo are synthetic. Licence: generated test fixture (no external attribution).

Source attribution is not an endorsement or partnership with the App.
